sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 15

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 15:1
items.html: The Rosh of AA is the root for the whole of Atzilut in general, both for Hochma and for Hassadim. And the Garon [throat] of AA, although it came out from the discernment of the Rosh of AA, is also discerned as a Rosh and a Keter, but only with regard to the Guf alone, which is Hassadim, as is known. For the Garon of AA is a Keter to AVI, who are the discernment of covered Hassadim. And accordingly the Garon of ZA is discerned as the phase of Rosh and Keter, while it is in the discernment of a Guf without a Rosh. Now, the Rosh of ZA is drawn from the GAR of NHY of AA, as is known — namely, from what rose and became HGT of AVI at the time of Gadlut. And behold, at the pregnancy of ZA, although then too NHY rose and became HGT, nevertheless only the two upper thirds of NH rose, while Yesod did not rise to join HGT, because of its being below the screen of Sium standing behind Tifferet. Thus only the two upper thirds of NH became the discernment of Rosh, namely HGT, but the Yesod came out of the discernment of the Rosh of ZA, since it did not rise to the discernment of HGT.
